shortDescription: Allows the management of firewall objects in FortiManager

options.name: adom
options.description: The ADOM the configuration should belong to.

options.name: allow_routing
options.description: Enable/disable use of this address in the static route configuration.

options.name: associated_interface
options.description: Associated interface name.

options.name: cache_ttl
options.description: Minimal TTL of individual IP addresses in FQDN cache. Only applies when type = wildcard-fqdn.

options.name: color
options.description: Color of the object in FortiManager GUI. Takes integers 1-32

options.name: comment
options.description: Comment for the object in FortiManager.

options.name: country
options.description: Country name. Required if type = geographic.

options.name: end_ip
options.description: End IP. Only used when ipv4 = iprange.

options.name: fqdn
options.description: Fully qualified domain name.

options.name: group_members
options.description: Address group member. If this is defined w/out group_name, the operation will fail.

options.name: group_name
options.description: Address group name. If this is defined in playbook task, all other options are ignored.

options.name: ipv4
options.description: Type of IPv4 Object. Must not be specified with either multicast or IPv6 parameters.

options.name: ipv4addr
options.description: IP and network mask. If only defining one IP use this parameter. (i.e. 10.7.220.30/255.255.255.255) Can also define subnets (i.e. 10.7.220.0/255.255.255.0) Also accepts CIDR (i.e. 10.7.220.0/24) If Netmask is omitted after IP address, /32 is assumed. When multicast is set to Broadcast Subnet the ipv4addr parameter is used to specify the subnet.

options.name: ipv6
options.description: Puts module into IPv6 mode. Must not be specified with either ipv4 or multicast parameters.

options.name: mode
options.description: Sets one of three modes for managing the object.

options.name: multicast
options.description: Manages Multicast Address Objects. Sets either a Multicast IP Range or a Broadcast Subnet. Must not be specified with either ipv4 or ipv6 parameters. When set to Broadcast Subnet the ipv4addr parameter is used to specify the subnet. Can create IPv4 Multicast Objects (multicastrange and broadcastmask options -- uses start/end-ip and ipv4addr).

options.name: name
options.description: Friendly Name Address object name in FortiManager.

options.name: obj_id
options.description: Object ID for NSX.

options.name: start_ip
options.description: Start IP. Only used when ipv4 = iprange.

options.name: visibility
options.description: Enable/disable address visibility.

options.name: wildcard
options.description: IP address and wildcard netmask. Required if ipv4 = wildcard.

options.name: wildcard_fqdn
options.description: Wildcard FQDN. Required if ipv4 = wildcard-fqdn.
